posts.author: MercuryArtes
posts.body: Hi all! A friend recommended this forum to me. I'm a hobbyist artist with RPG Maker XP and MV, though I'm mainly interested in learning VN Maker!

posts.author: NekoCassowary
posts.body: Welcome! I'm curious as to what you're making with VN Maker - I've been interested in the idea of making a visual novel, but I've only poked around in Ren'Py a little and never actually made anything with it.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum! I have VN Maker, but at this rate, if I make anything like a Visual Novel, I will probably make it in MZ since that is what I am most comfortable with and it is very flexible.
This forum really is a great place to get assistance, resources, to learn, and to just socialize if you like to.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
